newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics surges on Q4 report, outlook.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics surges on Q4 report, outlook.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp shares surged nine percent Tuesday morning after the company late Monday reported in-line quarterly results and projected demand for all product lines will continue to grow substantially in fiscal 1997.
Shares of the leading producer of modems and other communications products and systems rose 5-1/4 to 64-3/4.
Arnie Owen, director of equities at Kaufman Brothers, noted the stock "was down big the other day because of the layoffs and now it's back (on the earnings and forecast). It's a good company."

The company reported fiscal fourth quarter ended September 30 share earnings climbed to $0.71 from $0.37 a year ago. Fiscal 1996 results exclude a one-time charge related to the company's acquisition of Scorpio Communications Ltd.

U.S. Robotics also said on Monday it expects overall revenues in fiscal year 1997 to be in line with analysts' estimates of just below $3 billion. The company reported fiscal 1996 revenues of $1.98 billion.
